translations.오늘 품절·예약·미완료 업무를 읽고 본인 업무에 영향을 주는 항목을 하나: Read today's sold-out items, reservations and unfinished work, and identify each item affecting your work.
Check the date first so you do not mistake yesterday's notes for today's notice.
translations.담당과 도움받을 사람 확인: Confirm responsibilities and who can help
translations.빈 근무 시간과 오늘 버디를 확인하고 모르는 업무를 누구에게 물을지 정해: Check uncovered shift times and today's buddy, and decide whom to ask about unfamiliar work.
Agree on responsibilities before starting equipment work you cannot do alone.
translations.내 구역을 한 바퀴 돌고 부족한 준비를 담당자에게 직접 알려요. 인수인계: Walk around your area and tell the responsible person directly about missing preparations. Confirm the handover is complete.
Reading the notes is different from finishing the preparations.
translations.전처리 도구와 작업대 준비: Prepare food-prep tools and work surfaces
translations.원물과 완성식품 구역 나누기: Separate raw ingredients and ready-to-eat food areas
Prepare raw and ready-to-eat ingredients with separate containers and tools, and check labels.
Check each tool's purpose rather than relying only on its color.
translations.작업대 세척 후 준비: Clean the work surface before preparing
translations.찌꺼기와 오염을 먼저 제거하고 매장 제품 지침대로 세척·소독해요. 필요한: Remove debris and contamination first, then clean and sanitize according to the store product instructions. Check the required contact time and rinsing.
Do not finish by merely spraying sanitizer onto a dusty surface.
translations.오늘 사용할 양만 소분: Portion only the amount needed today
translations.예상 주문과 레시피에 맞춰 소분하고 재료명·준비 시각·사용 기준을 표시해: Portion according to expected orders and recipes; label the ingredient name, preparation time and use criteria.
Check remaining stock before deciding additional prep quantities to avoid duplicate preparation.
translations.설거지 구역 정리 확인: Check the dishwashing area is organized
Empty food scraps and arrange dishes so dirty and clean dish routes do not cross.
Do not return clean dishes to a dirty basket.
translations.매장 세척기·세제 지침대로 처리한 뒤 음식물과 세제 잔여를 확인하고 지정: Follow the store dishwasher and detergent instructions, check for food and detergent residue, then place dishes on the designated drying rack.
Check that moisture is not trapped between stacked dishes.
translations.배수망과 바닥 정리: Clear drain strainers and tidy the floor
translations.배수망 찌꺼기를 수거하고 도구를 제자리에 둬요. 물기를 정리한 뒤 통로를: Collect debris from drain strainers and return tools to their places. Clear moisture before opening the passage.
Do not finish by placing only a warning sign on a wet floor.
translations.손 씻기와 위생복·위생모 착용: Wash hands and put on hygienic clothing and a hair covering
translations.탈의 후 비누로 30초 이상 손을 씻고 매장 위생복·위생모(주방은 마스크: After changing, wash hands with soap for at least 30 seconds and wear the store's hygienic clothing and hair covering (a mask in the kitchen). Cover hand wounds with waterproof dressings and gloves, and tell the supervisor.
translations.앞치마를 화장실까지 입고 가지 않아요. 휴대폰을 만졌으면 다시 손을 씻어: Do not wear your apron into the toilet. Wash hands again after touching your phone.
translations.설사·구토·발열·인후통이 있으면 조리·배식 전에 사장님이나 매니저에게 먼: Tell the owner or manager before cooking or serving if you have diarrhea, vomiting, fever or a sore throat. The owner maintains records of health examinations 1 time a year (typhoid, paratyphoid and pulmonary tuberculosis).
Store rules require reporting illness, rather than working through it.
translations.마감 메모에서 품절 재료, 남은 육수·초벌 등뼈 양, 예약, 고장 난 장: Check closing notes for sold-out ingredients, remaining broth and parboiled pork spine quantities, reservations and broken equipment; identify what affects your work.
Check the date first. It is easy to mistake yesterday's notes for today's situation.
translations.오픈·피크·마감 담당과 오늘 버디를 확인해요. 혼자 하기 어려운 육수 솥: Check who handles opening, peak hours and closing, and today's buddy. Assign responsibility before starting broth-pot or burner work that is difficult to do alone.
Asking before unfamiliar work is the quickest way to proceed.
translations.오픈 · 홀과 셀프바 준비: Opening: prepare dining area and self-service station
translations.간판·조명·냉난방 켜고 안내문 확인: Switch on signage, lighting and climate control; check notices
translations.간판과 홀 조명, 냉난방을 켜요. 출입문의 영업시간(11:30~22:00: Switch on signage, dining-area lights and heating or air conditioning. Check that entrance notices clearly show business hours (11:30~22:00), break time (14:00~16:00, excluding weekends) and last orders at 21:30.
Missing notices mean twice as much explaining to customers.
translations.테이블마다 휴지·물티슈·앞접시 받침·뼈 버리는 통을 놓고 의자를 정렬해요: Put tissues, wet wipes, side-plate stands and bone-disposal containers on each table; align chairs. Check a trivet is present where a hot pot will be placed.
Sticky table surfaces are easier to see under bright opening-time lighting than during closing.
translations.앞접시·국그릇·수저·집게를 채우고 밑반찬(매장 구성)을 반찬통에 담아 뚜: Stock side plates, soup bowls, cutlery and tongs. Put the store's side dishes into containers and cover them. Provide separate tongs for each dish and label the filling time.
Refill customer-served side dishes frequently in small amounts to reduce waste.
translations.소금·후추·양념통과 물 준비: Prepare salt, pepper, condiments and water
translations.셀프바 옆 소금·후추·다대기 통을 채우고 정수기·물병·컵을 확인해요. 뼈: Fill salt, pepper and spicy seasoning containers beside the self-service station; check the water dispenser, bottles and cups. Customers often use these seasonings with pork-bone soup.
Wash and dry salt shakers with blocked lid holes before refilling.
translations.매장 주차 공간의 장애물과 입구 바닥·유리를 정리해요. 우천 시 우산 꽂: Remove obstacles from the store's parking spaces and clean the entrance floor and glass. In rain, put out an umbrella stand and slip warning signs.
Tidy the entrance in the last 5 minutes before the first customers arrive.
translations.라벨의 부위·중량·입고일을 확인하고 색과 냄새가 정상인지 봐요. 이상하면: Check the cut, weight and arrival date on the label, and ensure color and smell are normal. If abnormal, do not use it; notify the owner with a photo.
Recording thawing start time for frozen pork spine helps calculate blood-soaking time.
translations.찬물(매장 레시피의 설탕물 여부)에 등뼈를 담가 매장 기준 시간 동안 핏: Soak pork spine in cold water (check whether the store recipe uses sugar water) for the store-specified time, changing the water during soaking. Mark the start time on the container.
translations.핏물이 덜 빠지면 육수가 탁하고 잡내가 나요. 시간을 눈대중으로 줄이지: Insufficient blood removal makes broth cloudy and unpleasant-smelling. Do not shorten the time by guesswork.
translations.끓는 물에 매장 향신채(월계수잎·통후추·생강·소주 등 레시피 기준)를 넣: Add the store recipe's aromatics (bay leaves, whole peppercorns, ginger, soju, etc.) to boiling water; parboil pork spine for the specified time and discard the water.
Never use the parboiling water as broth.
translations.흐르는 찬물에 뼈를 하나씩 헹궈 핏덩이·뼈가루·불순물을 제거해요. 씻은: Rinse each bone under running cold water to remove blood clots, bone dust and impurities. Put washed bones into a clean dedicated tray.
Do not mix tools used for raw bones with trays holding washed bones.
translations.소·중·대 기준 무게(매장 레시피)로 나눠 용기에 담고 재료명·소분 시각: Divide into small, medium and large portions by the store recipe's weights; label ingredient name, portioning time and use criteria, then refrigerate.
Use evening reservations and yesterday's sales to plan portions and reduce leftover bones.
translations.준비 · 육수와 기본 뼈곰탕 국물: Preparation: broth and basic pork-bone soup
translations.솥의 물량과 초벌 등뼈·대파·마늘·생강 등 매장 레시피 재료를 확인하고: Check the water quantity, parboiled pork spine and recipe ingredients such as spring onion, garlic and ginger, then turn on the heat. Record the start time.
After opening the gas valve, stay until you confirm ignition.
translations.거품·기름 걷기와 불 조절: Skim foam and fat; adjust heat
translations.끓기 시작하면 거품과 기름을 걷고 매장 기준 화력으로 낮춰요. 물이 줄면: When boiling begins, skim foam and fat and lower heat to the store standard. If water decreases, top up only with hot water.
Cold water makes the soup cloudy and lengthens cooking time.
translations.오늘 주문에 제공할 식전 국물 종류와 품절 대체 기준을 담당자에게 확인해: Ask the responsible person which starter soup is served with today's orders and how to substitute sold-out items. Reviews mention pork-bone broth, bean-sprout soup and no starter soup; do not label it as included with every order.
Do not mix yesterday's soup left at the bottom of the warmer into fresh soup.
translations.어제 보관한 육수가 있으면 사장님·매니저에게 사용 여부를 확인받고, 승인: If stored broth from yesterday remains, ask the owner or manager whether it may be used; reheat and use only approved broth.
Do not decide to use it just because it smells acceptable.
translations.준비 · 양념·사리·사이드: Preparation: seasonings, add-ons and side dishes
translations.뼈찜 양념장 소분: Portion sauce for braised pork spine
translations.산뼈찜과 화산뼈찜의 오늘 판매 옵션·매운 단계와 매장 승인 양념 준비 기: Check today's San and Hwasan braised-pork-spine options, spice levels and approved sauce-preparation standards; label each container. Enter proportions and quantities only after the store recipe is finalized.
Distinguish similarly colored sauces by labels, not their locations.
translations.오늘 메뉴별 소스 제공 기준을 담당자에게 확인하고 종류별 준비분을 식별해: Ask the responsible person about today's sauce service for each menu item and identify each prepared batch. Reviews describe different sauces such as soy-mustard sauce for San and mayonnaise sauce for Hwasan braised pork spine; do not fix these as universal.
translations.소스 종류와 제공 여부를 주문별로 확인해요. 화산뼈찜에 마요소스가 제공된: Check sauce type and whether it is served for each order. Some reviews also describe mayonnaise sauce with Hwasan braised pork spine.
translations.사리·볶음밥 재료 확인: Check noodle add-ons and fried-rice ingredients
translations.오늘 판매하는 우동·칼국수사리와 계란볶음밥·식후 볶음밥을 구분해 준비분을: Check today's udon and kalguksu noodle add-ons, egg fried rice and after-meal fried rice separately. Confirm separate or combined noodle service and its timing against the order ticket and store standards.
translations.피크에 사리가 떨어지면 주문을 못 받아요. 준비 시간에 세는 것이 가장: Running out of noodle add-ons at peak time prevents taking orders. Counting during preparation is easiest.
translations.감자·우거지·채소 손질: Prepare potatoes, cabbage greens and vegetables
translations.감자·우거지(시래기)·콩나물·대파를 매장 레시피 크기로 손질해 용기에 담: Cut potatoes, cabbage greens (dried radish greens), bean sprouts and spring onions to the store recipe's sizes; put them into containers and label preparation times.
Use separate cutting boards for raw bones and vegetables.
translations.뼈찜 위에 꽂는 깃발 등 데코 소품과 집게·가위·앞접시 예비분을 배식대에: Stock serving counters with decorations such as flags placed on braised pork spine, plus spare tongs, scissors and side plates.
Replace wet or torn decorations immediately.
translations.주문번호·테이블과 메뉴(산뼈찜·화산뼈찜·뼈곰탕·뼈짬뽕), 수량·사이즈·맵: Check the order number, table and menu (San or Hwasan braised pork spine, pork-bone soup or pork-bone spicy noodle soup), quantity, size, spice level, noodle/rice choice, add-ons, fried-rice type and exclusions.
Standardize order-ticket notation so portion size is not confused with party size.
translations.주문 메뉴와 사이즈·맵기·제외 요청을 준비분에 대조하고 매장 책임자가 승: Match the ordered menu, size, spice level and exclusions to prepared portions; confirm the cooking procedure and completion criteria approved by the store supervisor. Do not determine times, heat or ingredients from reviews alone.
Check cooking time, heat and doneness against the manual approved by the store supervisor.
translations.완성 확인과 마무리: Check the finished dish and final details
translations.본품과 주문표를 대조한 뒤 오늘 매장 기준에 맞는 동반 소스·국물·사리의: Match the main dish to the order ticket; confirm today's sauce, soup and noodle types and whether served separately or together. Reviews describe different service styles, so do not assume a single fixed method.
translations.우동사리가 별도로 나온 후기와 본품에 함께 나온 후기가 있어요. 오늘 기: Some reviews describe udon served separately and others together with the main dish. Check today's standard.
translations.계란볶음밥 추가 주문과 식후 볶음밥 요청을 별개 항목으로 확인해요. 실제: Treat additional egg fried rice orders and after-meal fried rice requests as separate items. Follow store standards for actual product relationships and cooking/service timing; coordinate order changes with the dining-area team.
After receiving an actual after-meal request, match the order number and table.
translations.완성된 냄비는 받침 위에 올려 배식대에 두고 홀에 콜해요. 냄비 손잡이와: Place the finished pot on a trivet at the serving counter and call the dining-area team. Check pot handles and broth overflow.
Pots left at the serving counter too long lose both temperature and appearance.
translations.주문에서 메뉴·사이즈·맵기·사리·면/밥 선택·볶음밥·제외 요청을 확인해요: Confirm menu, size, spice level, noodle add-ons, noodle/rice choice, fried rice and exclusions. Check today's store standard before explaining sauces and starter soup.
Do not assume options mentioned in reviews are today's available menu.
translations.기본 국물과 셀프바 안내: Explain starter soup and self-service station
translations.오늘 매장 기준에 따라 식전 국물 제공 여부와 셀프바 이용 방법을 안내해: Explain whether starter soup is served and how to use the self-service station according to today's store standards. Reviews differ on soup type, sold-out substitutions and no-soup service; do not claim it is always included.
If soup is sold out, confirm approved substitutes and explanation wording.
translations.뼈찜 세팅: Set up braised pork spine service
translations.뜨거운 본품과 주문표의 사리·소스·추가품을 대조해요. 사리의 제공 시점과: Match the hot main dish with noodle add-ons, sauces and extras on the order ticket. Check store standards and customer requests for noodle timing and separate or combined service.
Move water cups off the table before putting down the pot.
translations.중간 수거와 반찬 보충: Clear dishes during the meal and refill side dishes
Collect bone containers and empty dishes during meals; refill self-service side dishes before they run out. Mark the refill time.
Replace containers rather than pouring fresh side dishes onto leftovers.
translations.결제와 라스트오더 안내: Take payment and explain last orders
translations.결제 시 주문 내역을 확인하고 21:00 이후 입장 손님에게는 라스트오더: Check order details at payment; tell customers arriving after 21:00 that last orders are at 21:30.
Tell customers arriving just before the break when service ends as you seat them.
translations.피크 · 포장·배달 주문: Peak hours: takeaway and delivery orders
translations.지정된 포장 구역에서 손을 30초 이상 씻고 위생장갑·위생모·마스크를 착: In the designated packing area, wash hands for at least 30 seconds and wear hygienic gloves, a hair covering and a mask. Replace gloves after other work.
Ask delivery drivers not to enter the kitchen or packing area.
translations.식품용 표시가 있는 깨끗한 용기에 집게·국자로 담아요. 뼈찜 본체, 사리: Use tongs or ladles to fill clean containers labeled for food use. Pack braised pork spine, noodle add-ons, special sauce, side dishes and fried rice separately; keep hot and cold food from touching.
Fill broth-heavy braised pork spine only to the store's specified container fill line.
translations.밀폐와 주문 대조: Seal and check against the order
translations.뚜껑을 닫고 기울여 국물이 새지 않는지 확인한 뒤 주문표와 메뉴·사이즈·: Close the lid and tilt to check for broth leaks; then match menu, size, noodles, sauces and cutlery count to the order ticket.
Checking before closing the bag avoids reopening it.
translations.포장을 마치면 바로 출고 선반에 두고 주문 번호를 표시해요. 외부에 오래: As soon as packing is finished, put the order on the dispatch shelf and label its number. Do not leave it outside for long.
Tell the dining-area team immediately if the delivery app's estimated time is delayed.
translations.브레이크타임 · 정리와 저녁 준비: Break time: cleanup and dinner preparation
translations.14:00에 출입문 안내를 브레이크(16:00 재오픈)로 바꾸고 식사 중: At 14:00, change the entrance notice to break time (reopening at 16:00); let customers already eating finish comfortably. There is no break on weekends.
Include reopening time when answering phone enquiries.
translations.홀·셀프바 정리: Tidy the dining area and self-service station
translations.테이블과 바닥을 정리하고 셀프바 반찬은 뚜껑을 덮어 냉장 보관하거나 매장: Tidy tables and floors; cover and refrigerate self-service side dishes or handle them according to store disposal criteria. Replace side-dish containers and tongs.
Do not reuse side dishes for dinner that sat out for a long time at lunch.
translations.육수·초벌 등뼈 점검: Check broth and parboiled pork spine
translations.육수 잔량과 상태를 보고 저녁용을 보충해요. 저녁 예약과 점심 판매량으로: Check remaining broth and its condition, then top up for dinner. Use evening reservations and lunch sales to plan parboiled pork spine portions.
Note sizes that ran short during the lunch rush to speed up dinner preparation.
translations.우동사리·계란·밥·포장 용기·앞접시 예비분을 세고 부족한 것은 앱의 보충: Count udon add-ons, eggs, rice, packing containers and spare side plates; record shortages as replenishment requests in the app.
Decide dinner orders during the break so they are not late.
translations.직원 식사와 휴식을 교대로 하고 16:00 재오픈 5분 전 각자 자리로: Take staff meals and breaks in rotation; return to your stations 5 minutes before reopening at 16:00.
Rest time is part of the shift too. Do not call someone unless it is urgent.
translations.육수와 초벌 등뼈 처리: Handle broth and parboiled pork spine
translations.남은 육수·초벌 등뼈·양념장은 사장님·매니저 기준에 따라 보관 또는 폐기: Store or discard remaining broth, parboiled pork spine and sauces according to owner/manager standards. Divide stored portions into small containers and mark the date and time.
Leaving food in a large pot makes its center cool slowly.
translations.감자·우거지·사리·볶음밥 재료를 뚜껑 덮어 냉장 보관하고 소비 기준을 표: Cover and refrigerate potatoes, cabbage greens, noodles and fried-rice ingredients; label use criteria. Keep raw bones and prepared vegetables in separate compartments.
Keep them in consistent locations so tomorrow's prep person can find them.
translations.화구·후드·솥 세척과 가스 차단: Clean burners, hood and pot; shut off gas
translations.화구와 후드 필터, 육수 솥을 매장 세제 지침대로 세척하고 가스 밸브를: Clean burners, hood filters and broth pots according to store detergent instructions; close the gas valve.
The last person checks the gas valve one more time.
translations.식기 세척과 배수망 정리: Wash dishes and clear drain strainers
translations.냄비·앞접시·뼈 통을 세척해 건조대에 놓고 배수망 찌꺼기를 비워요. 바닥: Wash pots, side plates and bone containers; place them on the drying rack. Empty drain-strainer debris and remove water from the floor.
Bone containers retain odors easily; rinse them once more with hot water.
translations.냉장고 정리와 인수인계 메모: Organize the refrigerator and write handover notes

translations.변경사항을 담당자와 고객에게 전달하고 합의한 내용을 필요한 범위로 기록해: Tell the responsible person and customer about changes; record agreements only as needed.
Check services completed and requests remaining; hand over to the follow-up person.
translations.보관 장소별 수량과 사용 가능한 상태를 확인한 뒤 필요한 구매량을 정해요: Check quantities and usability by storage location before deciding purchases needed.
translations.품목·수량·납기와 실제 입고를 대조하고 파손이나 누락은 분리해 담당자에게: Compare items, quantities and delivery dates to actual receipts; separate damage or shortages and report them.
Record arrival locations and handling results so the next person can find them.
translations.청소할 구역과 출입 제한이 필요한 곳을 확인해요. 제품 표시와 현장 지침: Identify areas to clean and places needing restricted access. Prepare tools matching product labels and site instructions.
translations.사용자 동선을 확보하고 구역별 승인된 순서로 청소해요. 서로 다른 약품을: Keep user routes safe; clean in each area's approved order. Do not arbitrarily mix different chemicals.
Check wet floors and remaining items; hand over unfinished work or facility issues.
translations.시설 이상 발견·조치 인계: Identify facility issues and hand over action
translations.출입 동선과 사용 설비의 눈에 보이는 이상을 확인해요. 장비를 임의로 분: Check visible abnormalities in access routes and equipment used. Do not disassemble equipment without permission.
translations.이상 사용 중지·보고: Stop unsafe use and report issues
translations.위험한 상태는 접근과 사용을 멈추고 현장 책임자에게 위치와 상태를 알려요: Stop access and use in dangerous conditions; tell the site supervisor the location and condition.
Record the person responsible for action and unresolved matters; hand over to the next shift.
translations.근무·담당·신규 크루 인계: Hand over shifts, responsibilities and new crew
Check today's staffing, vacancies and responsibility for each task.
translations.새 크루의 버디와 교육 범위를 확인하고 혼자 하면 안 되는 작업을 안내해: Check the new crew member's buddy and training scope; explain work they must not do alone.
Distinguish complete, incomplete and abnormal items; confirm with the next person.
translations.진행 중 고객 요청·물품·작업을 확인하고 보관 위치와 다음 담당을 정해요: Check ongoing customer requests, goods and work; assign storage locations and the next person.
translations.담당 권한 안에서 결제·취소·환불 기록을 대조하고 차이는 승인 없이 임의: Within your authority, compare payment, cancellation and refund records; do not arbitrarily adjust discrepancies without approval.
translations.시설 종료·다음 날 인계: Shut facilities and hand over for the next day
translations.현장 종료 지침에 따라 설비와 잠금 상태를 확인하고 다음 날 필요한 일을: Follow site closing instructions to check equipment and locks; hand over work needed tomorrow.
translations.요청·납기·결과물 인계: Hand over requests, deadlines and deliverables
Confirm requested deliverables, due dates and the inspection person.
Record change requests and agreements; tell the relevant responsible people.
Match final-deliverable versions and recipients; check access permissions.
translations.생산 작업 전후 인계: Handover before and after production work
Check work items, approved instructions, responsible people and required training.
translations.자재와 도구의 식별을 대조하고 손상·이상품은 정상품과 구분해 책임자에게: Match material and tool identifiers; separate damaged or abnormal items from good ones and tell the supervisor.
translations.결과·미완료 인계: Hand over results and unfinished work
Hand over completed quantities, unfinished work and issues using the site's recording method.
Check the approved scope, site supervisor and whether access or work permits are needed.
If site conditions differ from the work plan, do not start; check with the supervisor.
translations.종료·미해결 인계: Hand over closure and unresolved matters
Hand over work-area condition, remaining action and the next person responsible.
translations.작업·출하 기록 인계: Hand over work and dispatch records
translations.오늘 작업·출하 일정과 담당을 확인해요. 장비·약품은 승인된 지침과 교육: Check today's work/dispatch schedule and responsibilities. Use equipment and chemicals only within approved instructions and training.
Compare dispatched items, quantities, labels and destinations; separate and report abnormal goods.
translations.미완료·보관 인계: Hand over unfinished work and storage
Tell the next person where remaining goods are and what work is unfinished.
translations.접수·비진료 행정 인계: Hand over reception and non-clinical administration
Check appointment schedules and administrative responsibilities in the approved system.
Ensure sensitive information is not exposed on public screens or shared records.
translations.요청을 담당자에게 인계: Refer requests to the responsible person
Refer requests requiring clinical, medication or treatment decisions to the relevant professionals.
translations.CCTV 설치·안내·접근 기준 확인: Check CCTV installation, notices and access standards
Consult official guidance on whether the purpose and location are permitted.
translations.설치 목적·장소, 촬영 범위·시간, 관리책임자 연락처 등 필요한 내용을: Compare required information such as purpose/location, recording scope/time and responsible manager contact details with the notice board.
translations.접근 권한과 보관·처리 기준을 정하고 목적 외 이용이나 제공 요청은 담당: Set access, retention and processing standards; ask the responsible person about off-purpose use or disclosure requests.
translations.영업 인허가·등록 대상 확인: Check business licensing and registration applicability
translations.실제 영업과 대상 대조: Match actual business to applicable categories
translations.제공할 서비스와 품목을 정리하고 관계 법령상 허가·등록·신고 대상인지 확: List services and items to be provided; check whether relevant laws require permission, registration or notification.
translations.대상 업종의 관할 기관과 개시 전 절차를 확인하고 필요한 증빙과 변경 사: Identify the responsible authority and pre-opening procedures for the business type; organize required evidence and changes.
translations.우리매장 영업시간에 설정된 오늘의 브레이크 시작·종료 시각을 확인해 안내: Check today's break start/end times configured in Our store business hours and update notices. Do not arbitrarily apply specific times or exclude weekends.
translations.진행 중인 응대와 전달할 사항을 담당 파트에 남겨요. 영업 브레이크와 크: Leave ongoing service and handover matters with the responsible part. Business breaks and individual crew rest are separate; do not assign work during personal breaks.
At the configured reopening time, check notices and readiness of the responsible parts.
Tidy work surfaces and used tools; process according to store cleaning and sanitizing methods.
translations.남은 식품은 제품·공정별 보관 기준으로 처리해요. 시간·상태가 불명확한: Handle leftover food according to product/process storage standards. Do not serve food with unclear time or condition; tell the supervisor.
translations.다음 영업에 부족한 재료와 도구만 기존 재고·보충 요청에 남겨요. 같은: Record only ingredients and tools short for the next service in existing stock/replenishment requests. Do not record the same quantity again.
translations.등뼈·육수 다음 영업 준비: Prepare pork spine and broth for the next service
translations.예정 판매량과 남은 준비분을 확인해 초벌 등뼈·육수의 필요한 수량을 정해: Check expected sales and remaining prepared portions; determine needed quantities of parboiled pork spine and broth.
Check approved pork-spine prep, broth recipes and storage standards. Do not substitute reheating for an unclear cooked-food storage history.
translations.배치와 냉각 시작 확인: Identify the batch and cooling start
translations.육수인지 해산물 등이 들어간 완성 국물인지 구분해요. 실제 제조량·용기·: Distinguish stock from finished soup containing seafood or other ingredients. Record actual production quantity, containers, cooling equipment and start time. Do not leave a large pot at room temperature to cool slowly.
translations.매장에 검증된 용기 분할·냉각 방법을 사용하고 정해진 시점의 실제 시간·: Use store-validated container division and cooling methods; record actual times and temperatures at specified points. If outside standards, do not mark normal completion; hold use and notify the supervisor.
Label batch name, production/cooling times, storage location and use deadline confirmed by the store. Check history at next use. Do not arbitrarily apply one fixed storage duration to all spicy noodle soup.
translations.제품 표시의 보관방법과 소비기한을 확인해요. 실온 유통 밀봉 제품, 냉장: Check labeled storage instructions and use-by date. Distinguish sealed products distributed at room temperature, chilled/frozen products, and opened, thawed, soaked or cooked states.
translations.제품과 로트, 실제 개봉 시각, 매장에 확인된 개봉 후 보관조건·기한과: Record product and lot, actual opening time, store-confirmed after-opening conditions/deadline and location. Do not apply the sealed-product use-by date unchanged after opening.
translations.표시와 실제 보관 이력을 대조해요. 불린 떡에 일반 제품의 기간을 적용하: Compare labels to actual storage history. Do not apply ordinary-product durations to soaked rice cakes. Hold use and notify the supervisor if mold, other abnormalities or unclear history are found.
translations.개인 물품을 지정 장소에 두고 매장에서 정한 복장과 개인 위생 기준을 확: Put personal items in designated places; check store dress and personal-hygiene standards. Tell the supervisor before starting about health conditions or difficulties affecting work.
If standards are missing or hard to follow, ask the responsible person and record the situation.
translations.품절·예약·고장·미완료 업무를 이전 담당과 확인해요. 맡을 업무와 도움이: Confirm sold-out items, reservations, faults and unfinished work with the previous person. Decide what you will handle and what needs help; leave information for the next person.
translations.통행을 방해하는 물건을 정리하고 우리매장에 설정된 영업시간·브레이크 안내: Clear items obstructing passage; check that onsite notices match business hours and breaks set in Our store.
translations.테이블·의자의 상태와 청결을 확인하고 매장 제공 방식에 맞는 식기·비품을: Check table/chair condition and cleanliness; prepare dishes and supplies suited to the service method. Refill missing items from linked storage locations.
translations.셀프바를 운영하는 경우 취급 품목별 매장 기준에 맞춰 준비해요. 전용 도: If operating a self-service station, prepare each item according to store standards. Check dedicated tools, labels and storage; ask the supervisor about items with unknown standards.
translations.작업대·손 씻는 곳·도구의 준비 상태를 확인해요. 용도별 구분과 설비 사: Check readiness of work surfaces, handwashing places and tools. Follow store/manufacturer instructions for separation by purpose and equipment pre-use checks.
translations.오늘 메뉴와 준비량·품절 사항을 확인해요. 사용할 재료의 표시와 보관 상: Check today's menu, prep quantities and sold-out items. Check ingredient labels and storage; report abnormalities before use.
translations.재고와 사용 예정량, 입고 대기 주문을 함께 확인해요. 같은 품목을 중복: Check stock, planned use and orders awaiting arrival together. Compare units and quantities to avoid duplicate orders.
translations.공급처·규격·수량·납품 예정일을 확인하고 승인 권한에 맞춰 발주 요청을: Confirm supplier, specification, quantity and expected arrival date; pass requests according to approval authority. Distinguish demo orders in the app from actual supplier transmission.
translations.실제 도착한 품목의 이름·규격·수량을 주문과 비교해요. 누락·오배송·파손: Compare actual arrivals' names, specifications and quantities to orders. Separately record shortages, wrong deliveries and damage; notify the responsible person.
translations.품목별 검수 기준에 따라 표시·보관 상태를 확인해요. 기준에 맞지 않거나: Check labels and storage condition against each item's inspection criteria. Do not use items that fail or are hard to assess; ask the responsible person before handling them. Store only checked items in designated places and record receipt.
translations.품목별 지정 위치와 표시를 확인해요. 새 입고분과 기존 물품을 구분하고: Check each item's designated location and labels. Distinguish new arrivals from existing items and organize by store use order.
translations.대상 품목의 단위를 확인한 뒤 실물을 세어 기록해요. 수량 차이·표시 누: Check item units, count actual goods and record them. Tell the responsible person about discrepancies, missing labels or abnormal conditions. Follow inventory settings for checks after ordering.
translations.선택한 메뉴·재료의 매장 레시피와 준비량을 확인해요. 도구·작업 공간·사: Check store recipes and preparation quantities for selected menus/ingredients. Identify tools, workspace and supplies; if process standards are missing, ask the supervisor first.
translations.재료별 승인된 손질·해동·세척·소분 방법을 따라요. 사용한 재료와 준비: Follow approved preparation, thawing, washing and portioning methods for each ingredient. Label ingredients used and preparation status separately; move to specified storage.
translations.준비량·남은 작업·이상 사항을 다음 담당에게 전달해요. 실제 준비량은 준: Tell the next person prepared quantities, remaining work and issues. Compare actual prepared quantities with prepared-item records.
translations.메뉴·수량·옵션·제외 요청을 주문표와 대조해요. 알레르기 관련 요청은 추: Compare menu, quantity, options and exclusions to the order ticket. Handle allergy requests using confirmed ingredient information and supervisor instructions, not guesses.
translations.매장에서 확인한 레시피와 장비 지침에 따라 조리해요. 가열·냉각·재가열·: Cook according to store-confirmed recipes and equipment instructions. Use relevant validated standards and actual records for heating, cooling, reheating and holding hot.
translations.완성된 메뉴·수량·옵션·제공 상태를 확인하고 담당자에게 인계해요. 기준에: Check finished menu, quantities, options and serving condition; hand over to the responsible person. Address results that fail standards before serving.
Check seat, menu, quantity, options and customer requests; communicate accurately to the responsible person. Check ingredient/allergy questions you cannot answer before explaining.
translations.주문과 준비된 음식을 대조해 안내해요. 추가 요청·지연·불만은 담당자에게: Compare orders with prepared food and explain. Refer additional requests, delays and complaints to the responsible person and confirm handling.
translations.다음 손님 자리 준비: Prepare seats for the next customers
translations.사용 식기를 회수하고 매장 방법에 따라 테이블과 주변을 정리해요. 분실물: Collect used dishes and tidy tables/surroundings using store methods. Hand lost property to the designated person and replenish supplies.
translations.본품·옵션·소스·동반품을 주문표와 대조해요. 고객 요청과 제외 품목을 확: Match main items, options, sauces and accompanying items to the order ticket. Check customer requests and excluded items.
translations.메뉴에 적합한 용기와 매장 포장 방법을 사용해요. 뚜껑·누수·혼입 여부를: Use suitable containers and store packing methods. Check lids, leaks and unwanted mixing; attach required labels.
Compare order identifiers and give to the customer or driver at the designated location. Immediately refer omissions or wrong delivery to the supervisor.
translations.오늘 대상 구역·기구와 승인된 세척 방법을 확인해요. 용도별 청소도구를: Check today's areas/equipment and approved washing methods. Separate cleaning tools by purpose and check product instructions.
translations.대상에 맞는 매장 방법과 장비 지침에 따라 작업해요. 주변 식재료와 작업: Use store methods and equipment instructions suitable for the target. Keep work separate to avoid affecting nearby ingredients and tasks; return tools to designated places afterward.
translations.대상 구역과 기구가 다음 작업에 사용할 수 있는 상태인지 확인해요. 손상: Check that the area and equipment are ready for next use. Record damage, drainage problems and other abnormalities; tell the responsible person.
translations.바닥·세면대·변기·통행 상태를 확인하고 필요한 비품을 보충해요. 고장이나: Check floors, sinks, toilets and access; replenish supplies. Report faults or standing water.
translations.주방용과 구분한 도구 및 매장에서 승인한 제품 지침으로 청소해요. 사용: Clean with tools separate from kitchen tools and store-approved product instructions. Check in-use notices and completion; store tools in designated places.
translations.매장과 지역의 품목 구분에 따라 폐기물을 나눠요. 분류를 모르면 책임자에: Sort waste according to store and local item categories. Ask the supervisor if you do not know the classification.
translations.지정 장소로 배출: Take waste to the designated place
translations.연결된 배출 장소와 매장 배출 시점을 확인한 뒤 이동해요. 용기 주변 오: Check linked disposal locations and store disposal times before moving waste. Clean contamination/leaks around containers and clear passages.
translations.폐기물 보관 구역의 파손이나 해충 흔적은 담당자에게 알려요. 매장에서 승: Tell the responsible person about damage or pest signs in waste storage. Do not use unapproved chemicals or perform pest-control work without authorization.
translations.테이블·의자·바닥을 매장 청소 방법에 따라 정리해요. 손님 물품과 남은: Clean tables, chairs and floors using store methods. Check for customer belongings and remaining requests.
translations.취급 품목별 매장 보관·폐기 기준을 확인해 처리해요. 용기·도구는 지정: Check each handled item's store storage/disposal criteria and act accordingly. Wash/tidy containers and tools using specified methods; check readiness for next service.
translations.사용 중인 테이블 화구의 제조사·매장 종료 지침을 확인해요. 이상이나 종: Check manufacturer/store shutdown instructions for tabletop burners in use. Report abnormalities or uncertain shutdown status.
Sort and dispose according to store rules; use linked disposal locations.
Check dishes/supplies needed for next service and replenish from linked storage.
translations.시설 종료·인계: Shut down facilities and hand over
translations.종료할 설비와 계속 가동할 설비를 구분해 매장 지침에 따라 확인해요. 출: Distinguish equipment to shut down from equipment to keep running; check according to store instructions. Hand entrances and unfinished matters to the final responsible person.
translations.제품·공정별 확인된 매장 보관·폐기 기준에 따라 잔량을 처리하고 표시해요: Handle and label leftovers according to confirmed store storage/disposal standards for each product/process. Do not decide food with unclear standards is suitable for next service.
translations.작업대·식기·설비 정리: Tidy work surfaces, dishes and equipment
translations.오늘 세척 대상과 방법을 확인해 작업하고, 다음 사용에 필요한 상태를 확: Check today's washing targets and methods, do the work and confirm readiness for next use. Follow a separate plan for regular maintenance.
translations.계속 가동해야 하는 장비와 종료할 장비를 구별해 확인해요. 표시·보관 상: Distinguish equipment to keep running from equipment to shut down. Tell the next person about labels, storage conditions, faults and sold-out items.
translations.장비 목록과 제조사·매장 관리 계획에서 이번 대상·담당·작업 범위를 확인: Use the equipment list and manufacturer/store care plan to confirm current targets, responsibility and scope. Distinguish external contractor work from crew tasks.
translations.점검·정비 결과 인계: Hand over inspection and maintenance results
translations.허용된 작업만 수행하고 이상·조치·다음 점검 정보를 남겨요. 고장 장비의: Do only permitted work; record issues, action and next inspection information. Ask the supervisor whether faulty equipment may be used.
translations.이상·회수·영업 중단 대응: Respond to issues, recalls and service interruption
translations.고장·정전·이물·제품 회수 등 상황을 발견하면 대상과 발생 위치를 확인해: For faults, power outages, foreign matter or product recalls, identify the target and location and tell the supervisor. Follow onsite emergency instructions in urgent situations.
translations.책임자 지시에 따라 영향을 받은 물품·장비·주문을 구분하고 확인된 사실과: Under supervisor instructions, identify affected goods, equipment and orders; record confirmed facts and action. Do not reuse or restart on your own.
translations.조치 완료 여부와 남은 일을 다음 담당에게 전달해요. 영업·사용 재개는: Tell the next person what actions are complete and what remains. Resume business or use only following confirmation by the designated supervisor.
translations.담당 권한 안에서 결제·취소·환불 기록과 마감 자료를 대조해요. 차이가: Within your authority, compare payment, cancellation and refund records with closing documents. Report differences with evidence to the supervisor.
translations.미완료 주문·수리 요청·다음 영업 준비 사항을 담당과 함께 남겨요. 실제: Leave unfinished orders, repair requests and next-service preparation with responsible people. Distinguish these checks from actual payments or payroll processing.
translations.처음 하는 일은 동료와 함께 확인해 주세요. 모르는 점이나 위험한 상황은: Check unfamiliar work together with a colleague. It is okay to ask immediately about anything you do not understand or any dangerous situation.
translations.“10월 15일 목요일 저녁 7시, 네 분 예약이 맞으실까요?”처럼 날짜:
Read back the date, weekday, a.m./p.m., party size and reservation name, for example: “May I confirm a reservation for four people on Thursday, 10/15, at 7 p.m.?” Explain seat availability and the store’s approved rules for changing or cancelling reservations.

Completion: The same information is recorded on the reservation sheet and confirmed by the customer.
translations.“문의 감사합니다. 방문 때 뵙겠습니다”라고 마무리한 뒤 예약 또는 주문:
Conclude with “Thank you for your inquiry. I’ll see you when I visit,” and then connect the reservation or order record to the crew in charge. I do not transfer contacts to personal messengers or personal devices.

Completion criteria: The call is linked to work records and no unnecessary notes are left.
translations.“이 작업 끝났어요”, “다음 단계 같이 봐 주세요”를 말해봐요. 급한: Say “I’m done with this task,” or “Please take a look at the next steps together.” In case of urgent danger, we notify you right on the spot.
translations.“확인을 위해 잠시 기다려 주실 수 있을까요?”라고 묻고 보류해요. 오래:
I put it on hold by asking, “Could you please wait a moment for confirmation?” If it takes a long time, we inform them of the interim situation and convey the customer's questions and confirmed details when connecting to another person in charge.

Completion criteria: Know who and what your customers are waiting for.
translations.가열 장비 준비와 안전 동선 확인: Prepare heating equipment and check safe movement routes
translations.같은 이름의 다른 규격을 구분하고 중량·포장수·단가·최소 주문량을 대조해:
Distinguish between different specifications with the same name and compare weight, number of packages, unit price, and minimum order quantity. For substitute products with changed raw materials, check the menu and allergy information.

Completion criteria: You can check the item, specification, unit, delivery date, and quantity at once on the order form.
translations.같은 작업을 소량으로 함께 해봐요. 칼이나 장비는 설명과 감독을 받은 범: Try doing the same task together in small quantities. Use knives and equipment only within the scope of instruction and supervision.
translations.개·봉·중량 등 정한 단위로 세고 개봉분을 구분해 적어요. 두 사람이 세:
Count by determined units such as opening, bag, weight, etc., and write down the number of openings separately. For areas counted by two people, the overlapping range is divided first.

Completion criteria: Item, location, unit, actual quantity, inspection time remaining.
Store your personal items, wash your hands, and put on clean work clothes and a head covering. If you have physical conditions such as vomiting or diarrhea, or have wounds on your hands, notify the person in charge before handling the food and adjust the work.

Completion criteria: Sanitary preparations and personnel verification completed before food work.
translations.고객 맞이·대기·좌석 안내: Greeting customers, waiting, and seating information
translations.고객 요청을 적고 주방에 현재 진행 단계를 확인해요. 변경 가능 여부와:
Write down customer requests and check the current progress with the kitchen. After explaining whether changes can be made and the difference in price, make the changes in the approved manner and see if the revision slip has been sent to the kitchen.

Completion criteria: Existing and modified orders are distinguished and there is no duplicate cooking.
translations.고객 확인 후 주문을 구분해 전달: After customer confirmation, orders are sorted and delivered
translations.고객의 질문을 끝까지 듣기: Listen to customer questions until the end
translations.관찰한 사실과 임시 조치 기록: Records of observations and interim actions
translations.교육받은 장비만 제조사 절차로 가동해요. 손잡이·보호구·뜨거운 용기 받침:
Operate only trained equipment according to manufacturer procedures. Prepare handles, protective gear, and hot container trays, and clear the transport passage.

Completion criteria: Available equipment and disabled equipment are distinguished.
translations.구역별 쓰레기를 나누어 담고 지정 장소·시간에 배출해요. 용기와 주변 바:
Separate waste by area and dispose of it at a designated place and time. Clean up the container and the surrounding floor and wash your hands.

Completion criteria: There are no leftovers, leaks, or overflowing trash cans in the hall.
I asked my questions and was ready to start the next task with Buddy.
translations.권한 있는 담당이 해당 영업일 POS 마감과 승인된 결제·취소·환불 기록:
An authorized person compares the POS closing date for the business day with the approved payment, cancellation, and refund records. Check your belongings after shift alert and midnight, and deposit cash at a designated location.

Completion criteria: There are differences in the amount depending on the payment method.
translations.근무표에서 오늘 파트·교대·휴게를 확인하고 함께 일할 크루와 도움받을 버:
Check today's part, shift, and break on the work schedule and find a crew member to work with and a buddy to help. Distinguish between tasks involving heavy containers and equipment that cannot be handled alone.

Completion criteria: Can state who is in charge and how to ask for help.
translations.금액·수령 방법을 마지막으로 확인하기: Final confirmation of amount and method of receipt
translations.기한 임박, 포장 손상, 누출, 해동 흔적을 살펴요. 사용 가능한 임박품:
Look for signs of approaching expiration, packaging damage, leaks, or thawing. Distinguish between ready-to-use items and items awaiting disposal or judgment and deliver them to the person in charge.

Completion criteria: Prohibited materials are separated from sales inventory.
translations.기한·손상·격리품 점검: Check expiration, damage, and quarantined items
translations.깨끗이 준비된 테이블 번호를 확인하고 메뉴·주문 방법·물 위치를 짧게 설:
Check the clearly prepared table number and briefly explain the menu, ordering method, and location of the water. “When ordering, please tell us if you have any allergies or ingredients to avoid.”

Completion criteria: Table number is correct and menu and ordering instructions provided.
translations.깨끗한 곳에서 오염된 곳 순서로 청소: Clean from clean to contaminated areas
translations.깨끗한 음식이 나가는 쪽과 사용 식기가 돌아오는 쪽을 분리해요. 주문표:
Separate the side where clean food goes out and the side where used utensils come back. Check the order table location, completion call, and support request method.

Completion criteria: Ordered, finished products, and returned dishes can be found in each location without being mixed up.
translations.남은 식재료 사용 이력 확인: Check the use history of remaining food ingredients
translations.납품 차량에서 받은 품목을 주문서와 하나씩 맞춰요. 품명·규격·수량·단위:
Match the items received from the delivery vehicle with the order form one by one. Look at the product name, specifications, quantity, unit, lot, and deadline and write down the delivery time and supplier.

Completion criteria: Actual quantities and inconsistent items are recorded separately.
translations.내 구역과 교대 시간 확인: Check your zone and shift times
translations.내가 일할 위치와 이동 동선을 설명해 봐요. 낯선 장비는 사용 전에 물어: Explain where I will work and my route of movement. Ask about unfamiliar equipment before using it.
translations.냉장·냉동 등 제품 표시와 매장 기준에 맞는 장소로 옮겨요. 기존 재고와:
Move to a location that meets product labeling and store standards, such as refrigeration and freezing. Match existing inventory and order of use, but separate raw ingredients from ready-to-eat food.

Completion criteria: Labels and storage locations are linked with no ingredients left in the aisles.
translations.냉장·냉동고별 표시값을 해당 매장 기준과 대조해 기록해요. 문 패킹, 닫:
The displayed values for each refrigerator and freezer are compared with the store standards and recorded. Check door packing, closure, vent blocking, and leaks.

Completion criteria: The actual displayed value and inspection time for each equipment remain and the door closes.
translations.냉장·냉동고와 바닥 최종 확인: Final check of refrigerator, freezer and floor
translations.넘치기 전 밀폐·무게 확인: Check seal and weight before overflowing
translations.누가 언제 무엇을 발견했는지, 관련 주문·수량·위치, 실제로 한 조치를:
Write down who discovered what and when, related orders, quantities, locations, and actual actions taken. Guest contact information is only kept on approved restricted access routes.

Completion criteria: Follow-up staff can understand without mixing facts with speculation.
translations.누수·패킹·소음·필터 외관 점검: Inspect leakage, packing, noise, and filter appearance
translations.눈을 맞추고 인사하기: Make eye contact and say hello
translations.다음 납품 전 필요한 양 계산: Calculate how much you need before your next delivery
translations.다음 납품일까지의 예약·판매 예상량과 매장 안전재고를 합한 뒤 사용 가능:
Add the expected amount of reservations and sales until the next delivery date and the store's safety stock, then subtract the available stock and unstocked stock. Organize the required amount according to the packaging unit.

Completion criteria: You can explain the basis for the quantity required and the desired delivery date.
translations.다음 업무와 근무 시간을 확인해요. 계속 함께해야 하는 일과 맡을 수 있: Check the next task and working hours. Your buddy decides what tasks you must continue to do together and what tasks you can take on.
translations.담당자에게 발주 초안을 보여주고 승인된 경로로 주문했는지 확인해요. 주문:
Show the order draft to the person in charge and confirm that the order has been placed through the approved channel. Record the order confirmation number, expected delivery date, and unconfirmed items and convey them to the warehouse manager.

Completion criteria: Approval, actual order, and scheduled receipt are distinguished.
translations.당일 재료·준비량 대조: Comparison of ingredients and preparation amount on the day
translations.대기 시간과 순서 안내하기: Guidance on waiting time and order
translations.도구 분리 보관·손 씻기: Store tools separately and wash hands
translations.레시피·수량·사용 시점 확인: Check recipe, quantity, and timing of use
translations.레시피에 정한 투입 순서·분량·화력·시간을 따라요. 배치별 시작 시각을:
Follow the input order, amount, heat power, and time set in the recipe. Distinguish the start time for each batch and leave the time and temperature that need to be confirmed as the actual values.

Completion criteria: The menu has met the verified cooking completion criteria.
translations.마지막 손님 퇴석과 분실물을 확인한 뒤 식기·잔반을 수거해요. 테이블 번:
After checking the last guest’s departure and any lost items, we collect the dishes and leftover dishes. Arrange the contact surfaces, chairs, and floor in order of table number and inspect for damage.

Completion criteria: Each table is empty, clean and aisles are free of furniture.
translations.말을 끊지 않고 듣고 “불편을 드려 죄송합니다. 주문하신 내용과 제공된:
Listen without interrupting and say, “We apologize for the inconvenience. We will check what you ordered and what was provided.” We do not argue in front of other guests.

Completion criteria: A distinction has been made between the solution requested by the customer and the actual occurrence.
translations.매장 배출 안내에 따라 내용물과 포장재를 나눠요. 깨진 유리·날카로운 물:
Distribute contents and packaging materials according to store disposal instructions. For broken glass and sharp objects, use designated containers and markings.

Completion criteria: Contained in each type of container without contamination of foreign substances.
translations.매장 종료 목록에 따라 화구·작업 장비의 전원·밸브 상태를 하나씩 확인해:
Check the power and valve status of the cooking utensils and work equipment one by one according to the store shutdown list. We maintain facilities that are always in operation, such as refrigeration and freezing.

Completion criteria: Devices to turn off and devices to keep on match the list.
translations.매장명과 함께 전화 받기: Answer a call with the store name
The actual time and temperature are recorded according to the container dividing and cooling procedures verified in the store. Attach the product name, batch, expiration date, and storage location.

Completion criteria: Only quantities that meet verified cooling standards and storage conditions are stored.
translations.매장에서 정한 위생 절차를 함께 따라 해요. 식재료나 알레르기 정보가 불: We follow the hygiene procedures established by the store. If you are unsure about ingredients or allergy information, stop and ask.
translations.매장의 손 씻기, 복장, 식재료 구분과 알레르기 정보 확인 방법을 보여: Ask them to show you how to wash your hands, what to wear, how to distinguish ingredients, and check allergy information at the store.
I know the store’s hygiene procedures and how to check when I don’t know.
translations.메뉴 설명은 구성·맵기·양처럼 확인된 정보로 답해요. 추천은 “어떤 맛을:
Menu descriptions are answered with verified information such as composition, spiciness, and quantity. Recommendations start with “Which flavor do you prefer?” and if there is an additional cost, you will be notified before ordering.

Completion criteria: Understand the guest's menu selection and any additional costs.
translations.메뉴·가격·전화 안내 대조: Comparison of menus, prices, and phone information
translations.메뉴·수량·옵션·소스·사이드·접시 가장자리와 이물을 확인해요. 한 주문의:
Check the menu, quantity, options, sauce, side, edge of the plate, and foreign substances. Gather items from one order and coordinate the order of delivery with the hall or packaging manager.

Completion criteria: The order sheet matches the actual item, with no omissions or mix-ups with other orders.
translations.메뉴명·수량·옵션·제외 재료·포장 여부를 한 항목씩 적고 주방에 실제 준:
Write down the menu name, quantity, options, excluded ingredients, and packaging items one by one and check the actual preparation time with the kitchen. Allergy requests will be notified after confirming with the person responsible for the possibility of cross-contact with the raw materials.

Completion criteria: Kitchen and customer confirmed identical order and preparation times.
translations.메뉴별 승인 레시피에서 재료·배수·절단 크기를 확인해요. 첫 준비량과 추:
Check the ingredients, drainage, and cutting size in the approved recipes for each menu. Write down the initial preparation amount, additional preparation amount, and when to use it on the worksheet.

Completion criteria: There are a set of ingredients to prepare and how much to prepare.
translations.메뉴별 조리 순서 수행: Perform cooking sequence for each menu
translations.메뉴에 맞는 용기 준비: Prepare containers suitable for the menu
translations.모르면 멈추고 짧게 물어봐요: If you don't know, stop and ask briefly.
translations.목록 순서대로 접근 가능한 부분을 보고 정상 사진·제조사 기준과 비교해요:
Look at the accessible parts in the list order and compare them with normal photo and manufacturer standards. Leave the name of the equipment, symptoms, conditions, and photos.

Completion criteria: Normal, action required, and discontinued use are classified by equipment.
Look at door closures, display values, and shelf contamination, and tidy up floor stacking and ventilation openings. Do not place detergents or personal items on food.

Completion criteria: Can be removed while maintaining storage conditions and cleanliness.
translations.문제 품목에 사용 보류 표시를 붙이고 품명·수량·로트·사유·사진을 남겨요:
Attach a use pending sign to the problem item and leave the product name, quantity, lot, reason, and photo. Communicate the facts to the delivery department and person in charge to decide on a return or follow-up action.

Completion criteria: Hold items cannot be accidentally used by other crew members.
translations.미결 주문·정산 차이 확인: Check the difference between open orders and settlement
translations.미결제·중복·부분 취소와 배달 채널별 정산 차이를 목록으로 만들어요. 주:
Make a list of non-payment, duplication, partial cancellation, and settlement differences by delivery channel. Write down the order number, amount, current status, and follow-up person.

Completion criteria: There are two types: normal closing and waiting for confirmation.
Say hello to Minji and find the work area, storage area, and emergency exit together.
translations.민지님이 지켜보는 동안 식기 한 묶음을 처리해요. 세제나 장비 설정은 안: While Minji watches, I process a bundle of dishes. Use detergent and equipment settings after receiving guidance.
translations.밀폐·누수·외부 오염 확인: Check sealing, leakage, and external contamination
translations.반복된 불편과 미완료 업무 찾기: Finding repeated inconveniences and unfinished tasks
I practiced how to ask my buddy for help.
translations.버디와 주방 둘러보기: Take a tour of the kitchen with Buddy
translations.변경할 매뉴얼과 반복 업무 검토: Review manuals and repetitive tasks for changes
translations.보관 설비와 통풍 공간 확인: Check storage facilities and ventilation space
translations.보관 위치·라벨·사용 순서 정리: Organizing storage location, label, and order of use
translations.보관 장비 표시·문 닫힘 확인: Indication of storage equipment and confirmation of door closure
translations.보관대별로 품명·개봉 또는 준비 시각·매장 사용기한을 읽어요. 먼저 사용:
Read the product name, opening or preparation time, and store expiration date for each storage unit. First, we separate the raw materials and finished foods with the approved inventory to be used.

Completion criteria: Other crew members can immediately find the ingredients and the order of use.
translations.보관할 조리식품 냉각·표시: Cooling and labeling of cooked food for storage
translations.보류·연결에 먼저 동의 구하기: Ask for consent to hold/connect first
translations.부족·과잉·임박·격리 품목을 수량·위치와 함께 남겨요. 주문 후 재고 확:
Leave shortage, surplus, imminent, and quarantined items along with their quantity and location. If you are checking inventory after ordering, mark the order and record only the results.

Completion criteria: The person in charge has data to decide the next purchase, use, and disposal.
translations.분실물을 먼저 확인하고 식기·잔반을 수거해요. 테이블과 의자 접촉면을 정:
First check for lost items and collect dishes and leftovers. After cleaning up the contact surfaces of the table and chairs, place new clean furniture and look at the floor.

Completion criteria: You can receive the next guest without contaminated dishes or leftover dishes.
translations.불만·오주문·환불 요청 응대: Responding to complaints, incorrect orders, and refund requests
translations.불편·지연·추가 요청 처리: Handling inconveniences, delays, and additional requests
translations.비품 채우고 작동 확인: Fill in supplies and check operation
translations.빛 아래서 결과 확인·재개: Check results and resume under light
translations.사람과 공간부터 익혀요: Let’s learn about people and space first.
translations.사용 보류 표시를 붙이고 동일 재료·배치·주문의 범위를 확인해요. 제품과:
Put a pending use sign and check the scope of the same material, batch, and order. Products, packaging, labels, and related records are preserved in a manner determined by the person in charge.

Completion criteria: No other crew is selling or using the pending item.
translations.사용 중 표시와 비품 확인: Check signs and supplies during use
translations.사용하는 매장만 진행해요. 깨끗한 용기에 첫 제공분만 담고 품명·준비 시:
Only go to the stores you use. Put only the first serving in a clean container and mark the product name and preparation time. Place special tongs for each food and check storage conditions.

Completion criteria: Food, special tools, and markings match, and supplements are stored in designated locations.
translations.사용하는 매장만 진행해요. 제공했던 음식과 미제공 보관분을 나누고 보관:
Only go to the stores you use. We divide the provided food from the unprovided food and process it according to storage history and store standards. Wash and dry the side dish container, tongs, and screen.

Completion criteria: Food processing and utensil cleaning have been completed and there is no residue.
translations.사장님이 매뉴얼의 행동·완료 기준·이상 대응을 수정하고 내일 미리보기에서:
The boss revises the manual's actions, completion criteria, and response to abnormalities and checks the responsible department and schedule in tomorrow's preview. Explain to the crew the reason for the change and the effective date.

Completion criteria: Confirmed revisions and scope of future application.
translations.상시 가동 장비 목록을 먼저 확인해요. 종료 대상 조명·간판·냉난방만 끄:
First check which equipment must remain on. Switch off only the lights, signs, heating and cooling marked for shutdown, then check windows and doors. Leave notes about faults, reservations and unfinished work for the next person responsible.

Completion: Equipment that must stay on remains running; locks, closing time and the person who checked are recorded.
translations.생육·해산물과 바로 먹는 채소·완성식품의 도구·용기를 구분해요. 먼저 할:
Separate tools and containers for raw meat and seafood from those for ready-to-eat vegetables and finished foods. Decide what to do first and clean up your hands and work surface before starting.

Completion criteria: The prepared tools are separated by material and are clean.
translations.설비별 제조사 점검 권장 주기와 매장 기록을 대조해 다음 점검일·업체 연:
Check the next inspection date, company contact, and person in charge by comparing the manufacturer's recommended inspection cycle for each facility with store records. It does not replace routine cleaning that requires monthly inspection.

Completion criteria: Inspection schedule, responsibility, and necessary preparations have been organized.
translations.세척한 식기는 물이 빠지는 깨끗한 건조대에 두고 마른 뒤 보관해요. 청소:
Place washed dishes on a clean drying rack where water drains and dry before storing. Wash and dry cleaning tools and separate them with food and clean utensils.

Completion criteria: No contact with contaminated water or wet contaminated cloths again.
translations.셀프바 용기·도구·표시 준비: Preparation of self-bar containers, tools, and signs
translations.셀프바 음식·용기·도구 마감: Finishing of self-bar food, containers, and tools
translations.소등·문단속과 인계 완료: Lights out, door locked and handover completed
translations.소스·토핑·대체 재료까지 최신 원재료 자료를 확인하고 주방 책임자에게 공:
Check the latest raw material data, including sauces, toppings, and substitute ingredients, and ask the kitchen manager about the possibility of cross-contact with shared tools, oil, and work surfaces.

Completion criteria: The person in charge has reviewed the confirmed ingredients and whether they can be cooked.
translations.손 씻기·복장과 몸 상태 확인: Wash your hands, check your clothes and body condition
translations.손님 또는 기사에게 주문번호를 확인하고 봉투 수·음료·취급 주의를 전해요:
Confirm the order number with the customer or driver and inform them of the number of bags, drinks, and handling precautions. After actual receipt, the handover time and status are recorded.

Completion criteria: All envelopes have been delivered to the correct recipients.
translations.손님 말을 끊지 않고 사실을 확인해 주문번호·문제·요청을 책임자에게 전해:
Confirm the facts without interrupting the customer and convey the order number, problem, and request to the person in charge. Clearly state possible actions and when to provide guidance after confirmation.

Completion criteria: It is determined who will provide follow-up information.
translations.손님 사용 여부를 보고 청소 중 안내를 세워요. 휴지·비누·건조 수단,:
We check whether guests are using it and provide guidance during cleaning. Check toilet paper, soap, drying equipment, toilets and sinks for blockages, leaks, and lighting.

Completion criteria: Guides user access and provides information on supplementary and defective items.
translations.손님이 들어오면 하던 안전 작업을 마무리하고 “어서 오세요. 몇 분이세요:
When a customer comes in, I finish the safety work I was doing and say “Welcome. How many people are there?” If it is difficult to guide you right away, let them know first by saying, “Please wait a moment. I will guide you shortly.”

Completion criteria: Visitors and guides confirmed.
translations.손잡이·모서리·배수구와 바닥을 다시 보고 찌꺼기·잔여 제품·물기를 확인해:
Check the handles, edges, drains, and floor again to check for debris, remaining product, and moisture. Recover items and leave a cleanup time and unfinished portion.

Completion Criteria: Ensure clear surfaces and safe passageways before opening the area.
translations.수거부터 세척·건조·보관까지 매장의 순서를 봐요. 뜨거운 기구, 깨진 식: Look at the order of the store, from collection to washing, drying, and storage. Also check handling of hot utensils, broken dishes, and detergents.
translations.수령자 주문번호와 인계 대조: Comparison of handover with recipient order number
translations.승인 레시피의 배합·분량·장비·완료 기준을 열고 해당 배치의 라벨을 확인:
Open the mixing, quantity, equipment, and completion criteria of the approved recipe and check the label of the batch. Separate plates and tongs for finished products from raw material tools.

Completion criteria: Approved materials, tools, and work standards are met.
translations.승인 요청과 주문 확인 인계: Handover of approval request and order confirmation
translations.시범을 보고 옆에서 따라 해요: Watch the demonstration and follow along.
translations.시작 전 담당 구역 한 바퀴 확인: Check out your area before starting
translations.시작하기 전에 함께 확인해요: Let’s check together before we start.
If you find a food problem, foreign object, damage or a facility hazard, stop the affected work and food service. First ensure people are safe, then report the location, affected item, discovery time and situation to the person responsible.

Completion: The hazard area and affected orders have been identified.
translations.식품과 깨끗한 식기를 치우고 청소할 구역을 표시해요. 제품 라벨에서 적용:
Remove food and clean dishes and mark the area to be cleaned. Check the application surface, dilution, contact time, rinsing, and protective equipment on the product label and prepare tools specifically for the area.

Completion criteria: Food is not exposed and the correct products and tools are in place.
translations.식품용 용기를 확인하고 파손·오염·뚜껑 규격을 봐요. 뜨거운 것과 차가운:
Check food containers and check for damage, contamination, and lid specifications. Differentiate between hot and cold, soup and dry food according to store packaging standards.

Completion criteria: Have a clean container to hold the item and a matching lid.
Remove food, allow equipment to cool and stop safely, then clean to the permitted extent. Wash and dry knives, cutting boards, and containers, and empty the waste from the drain net.

Completion criteria: Tools are stored dry without food, oil, or product residue.
translations.실물과 주문표를 한 번 더 맞추고 무거운 용기는 아래에 놓아요. 봉투에:
Match the actual item with the order sheet once more and place the heavy container below. The order number and the total number of envelopes if there are multiple envelopes are indicated on the envelope.

Completion criteria: Packages per order are identified with no omissions.
translations.실재고·사용 가능량 확인: Check actual inventory and available quantity
translations.실제 받은 수량으로 입고 기록: Record receipt with actual received quantity
After checking the actual vacancy and clearance status, we will guide you to the expected waiting time. Only the waiting names and number of people are recorded where necessary, and contact information is received through store approval.

Completion criteria: The guest understands the queue, expected time, and method of calling.
translations.쓰레기통과 주변 누출을 전용 도구로 정리하고 손을 씻어요. 벌레·배설물·:
Clean up trash and surrounding spills with a special tool and wash your hands. The location and time of insects, excrement, and gnawed traces are recorded and notified to the person in charge.

Completion criteria: Empty container and surrounding area are clean and lid is closed.
translations.알레르기 요청 확인과 주방 전달: Allergy request confirmation and kitchen delivery
translations.알레르기 요청을 받으면 대상 재료와 주문 메뉴를 기록해요. “해당 재료와:
When I receive an allergy request, I record the target ingredients and order menu. Say, “I will confirm the ingredients and cooking process with the person in charge and then provide guidance.”

Completion criteria: Customer request is clearly recorded on order sheet.
translations.약속한 재제공·결제 취소가 실제로 처리됐는지 확인하고 고객에게 다시 알려:
We check whether the promised re-provision and payment cancellation have actually been processed and notify the customer again. Write down the details of the occurrence, actions taken, responsibility, and points to prevent recurrence in the handover.

Completion criteria: Distinguish between processing results and unfinished follow-up tasks.
translations.영업 영향과 안전 상태 확인: Check business impacts and safety conditions
translations.영업 중지 구역·대체 장비를 책임자와 정해요. 뜨거움·회전부가 멈추고 제:
Decide with the person in charge the area where business will be suspended and alternative equipment. Make sure that hot and rotating parts have stopped and are in a safe state according to the manufacturer's procedures.

Completion Criteria: Marked to prevent other crews from turning on the equipment they are working on.
translations.예약 날짜·시간·인원 되읽기: Review reservation date, time, and number of people
translations.예약 여부와 인원, 유아 의자·이동 편의가 필요한지 묻고 준비 가능한 좌:
We ask whether you have a reservation, the number of people, and whether you need a baby chair or transportation facilities, and check available seats. We do not guess a customer’s age, disability, or relationship based on their appearance.

Completion criteria: The reservation number matches the number of guests and the assistance needed has been confirmed.
translations.예약 인원과 좌석, 품절 메뉴, 대기 안내를 홀·주방 담당과 맞춰요. 현:
Coordinate reservation numbers, seats, sold out menus, and waiting information with the hall and kitchen staff. Explain to each other one change that is easy to ask questions about in the field.

Completion criteria: The hall and kitchen know the same sales menu and instructions.
translations.예약·예상 주문과 사용 가능한 잔량을 비교해 첫 준비분과 추가 준비분을:
Compare the reservation/expected order and the available remaining amount and write down the initial preparation amount and additional preparation amount. The product name, time, and usage standards on the label match the actual ingredients.

Completion criteria: You can find out how much to prepare for each menu and what items are lacking.
translations.오늘 날짜의 인계에서 미완료 주문, 품절 재료, 예약, 사용 중지 장비를:
Find unfulfilled orders, out-of-stock materials, reservations, and retired equipment in handovers for today's date. I ask all workers about the target, location, remaining actions, responsibility, and deadline.

Completion criteria: We confirmed who would complete what and when.
translations.오늘 맡길 재료 준비 한 가지를 보여 달라고 해요. 도구, 분량, 보관과: I ask you to show me one of the ingredients you will be entrusted with today. Check the tools, quantities, storage and display methods.
translations.오늘 맡을 간단한 작업 하나: One simple task to take on today
I know what I will do today and who to ask for help.
We knew the scope of work we could do today and checked the first results together.
translations.완료 수량·보관 위치·남은 원재료와 부족분을 담당자에게 전달해요. 도구를:
Communicate the completed quantity, storage location, remaining raw materials, and shortages to the person in charge. Clean tools and remove contamination from work surfaces and floors.

Completion criteria: The next worker can find the supplies and the area is cleared.
translations.완성품과 주문표 대조: Comparison of finished products and order sheets
translations.용기 세척과 해충 흔적 보고: Cleaning containers and reporting signs of pests
translations.용기 손잡이와 받침을 확인하고 이동 경로를 비워요. 주문번호·뜨거움·남은:
Check the container handle and base and clear the movement path. Tell the delivery person your order number, hotness, and remaining items and confirm delivery.

Completion criteria: The recipient and delivery order are confirmed.
translations.용기를 과하게 채우지 않고 뚜껑을 가장자리까지 닫아요. 안정된 상태에서:
Do not overfill the container and close the lid to the brim. In a stable state, check for sealing and leakage and clean the outside of the container.

Completion criteria: The lid does not lift or leak and does not tilt during transportation.
translations.용기를 닫고 품명·준비 시각·확인된 사용기한·보관 위치를 표시해요. 기존:
Close the container and indicate the product name, preparation time, confirmed expiration date, and storage location. Distinguish between existing stock and new preparations and leave only the necessary amount on the workbench.

Completion criteria: Another crew member can read the signs and use them in the correct order.
Check the discharge location and time of our store and move it to avoid the food preparation route. After discharging, close the lid and door and clear the passage.

Completion criteria: Comply with discharge rules and do not block entry/escape passageways.
translations.원재료 자료와 조리 환경 확인: Check raw material data and cooking environment
translations.음식물과 이물을 먼저 수거하고 배수망·틈새의 찌꺼기를 제거해요. 칼날·깨:
First, collect food and foreign substances and remove debris from the drain net and crevices. Do not sweep up blades or broken pieces by hand.

Completion criteria: Major contamination and hazardous materials have been removed prior to cleaning.
translations.음용수·컵과 소모품 채우기: Filling drinking water, cups and consumables
translations.이번 점검 대상·주기 확인: Check the target and frequency of this inspection
In case of abnormalities: Any changes in price or refund authority will be notified after confirmation by the manager.
translations.이상 시: 가스 냄새·연기·이상 소음은 작업을 중단하고 매장 비상 절차를: In case of abnormalities: If there is a gas odor, smoke, or abnormal noise, stop work and follow the store emergency procedures.
translations.이상 시: 가스 냄새·파손·잔열 위험이 있으면 조작을 중단하고 책임자에게: In case of abnormality: If there is a risk of gas odor, damage, or residual heat, stop operation and immediately notify the person in charge.
translations.이상 시: 같은 도구를 써야 하면 작업 사이 세척·소독 절차를 마친 뒤: In case of anomalies: If the same tool must be used, switch after completing the cleaning and disinfection procedures between tasks.
translations.이상 시: 거절 안내가 필요하면 이유를 짧게 설명하고 책임자 응대로 연결: In case of an abnormality: If rejection is required, briefly explain the reason and contact the person in charge.
translations.이상 시: 결제 취소 실패는 완료로 말하지 않고 실제 상태와 담당을 알려: In case of abnormalities: Payment cancellation failure is not indicated as complete, but the actual status and responsibility are notified.
translations.이상 시: 고장 징후는 정기일까지 미루지 말고 사용 중지와 책임자 보고를: In case of abnormalities: Do not postpone signs of malfunction until a regular date. Stop using the product and report it to the person responsible first.
translations.이상 시: 공간이 부족하면 담당자와 작업 시간을 나누고 임의로 식품 옆에: In case of abnormalities: If there is insufficient space, divide the work time with the person in charge and do not arbitrarily pile contaminated dishes next to the food.
translations.이상 시: 공간이 부족하면 부적절한 장소에 두지 말고 대체 보관을 승인받: In case of abnormality: If there is insufficient space, do not leave it in an inappropriate place and obtain approval for alternative storage.
translations.이상 시: 공급처와 처리 합의가 안 되면 임의 사용·폐기하지 말고 책임자: In case of abnormalities: If there is no agreement on disposal with the supplier, do not use or dispose of it arbitrarily, but leave it to the person in charge.
translations.이상 시: 공석이나 중복 배정은 책임자에게 알리고 임의로 다른 크루의 휴: In case of abnormalities: We notify the person in charge of any vacancies or overlapping assignments and do not arbitrarily cancel other crew members’ breaks.
In case of abnormalities: Do not post sensitive information in public notes or determine the cause.
In case of an abnormality: We do not arbitrarily process it by sharing a public password or transferring it to a personal account.
In case of abnormality: If there are no specifications, do not substitute a random container and check with the person in charge.
translations.이상 시: 금액이 다르면 기록을 맞추려고 임의 수정하지 말고 거래번호와: In case of abnormalities: If the amounts are different, do not arbitrarily modify the records to match them, but leave the transaction number and the difference.
translations.이상 시: 기록이 없으면 발생했다고 가정하지 말고 크루에게 사례를 확인해: In case of an abnormality: If there is no record, do not assume it occurred and check with the crew about the case.
translations.이상 시: 기준 이탈 시 재료의 시간·온도 이력을 확인하도록 책임자에게: In case of abnormality: In case of deviation from the standard, notify the person in charge to check the time and temperature history of the material, and normal processing will not be carried out arbitrarily.
If something is wrong: If the use-by date or handling history is unknown, do not judge safety by tasting.
In case of abnormalities: Remove broken dishes and wobbly chairs and place replacements.
In case of abnormality: Remove sharp objects with a tool and indicate the location of the damage.
In case of abnormalities: If there is overflow or damage to the container, stop moving and repackage safely.
In case of abnormalities: If there is water leakage, damage, or dangerous obstacles, block access and notify us first.
In case of abnormalities: If different orders are mixed, all are compared again.
In case of abnormalities: Substitute products will not be changed without approval.
translations.이상 시: 덜 마른 식기를 포개거나 더러운 행주로 닦아 마무리하지 않아요: In case of abnormalities: Do not stack less dry dishes or wipe them with a dirty dishcloth.
translations.이상 시: 뜨거운 국물을 무리하게 기울이거나 눌러 확인하지 말고 용기를: In case of abnormality: Replace the container without excessively tilting or pressing the hot soup.
translations.이상 시: 뜨거운 용기를 든 채 급하게 뛰지 않고 가까운 크루에게 응대를: In case of abnormalities: Instead of running quickly while holding a hot container, ask a nearby crew member to respond.
translations.이상 시: 라벨 없는 약품이나 용도가 다른 제품을 쓰거나 서로 섞지 않아: In case of abnormalities: Do not use or mix drugs without labels or products for different purposes.
In case of abnormality: Do not use materials without a label or history first, but separate and check.
translations.이상 시: 라벨을 추정해 새로 붙이지 말고 불명확한 재료는 사용을 보류해: In case of an abnormality: Do not guess and re-apply the label, and withhold use of unclear ingredients.
translations.이상 시: 만석이면 확정이라고 말하지 않고 가능한 시간 또는 대기 방식을: In case of abnormalities: If all seats are full, we do not say it is confirmed but suggest a possible time or waiting method.
In case of abnormalities: We do not arbitrarily promise combinations or prices that are not on the store menu.
translations.이상 시: 모르는 질문은 “정확히 확인하고 안내해 드리겠습니다”라고 말하: In case of a problem: If you have a question you don’t know, say, “I will check it clearly and guide you through it,” and confirm with the person in charge.
translations.이상 시: 몸 상태가 좋지 않거나 상처 보호가 어려우면 임의로 조리·배식: If something is wrong: If you feel unwell or cannot adequately protect a wound, do not start cooking or serving food on your own.
translations.이상 시: 문 고장이나 미끄럼이 남으면 해당 구역을 막고 책임자에게 알려: In case of abnormality: If the door is broken or slips, block the area and notify the person in charge.
translations.이상 시: 물이 이상하거나 장비 누수가 있으면 사용을 멈추고 대체 음용수: In case of abnormality: If the water is abnormal or the equipment is leaking, stop using it and decide with the person in charge about alternative drinking water.
translations.이상 시: 미완료는 완료로 체크하지 말고 남은 수량과 예상 마무리 시각을: In case of abnormalities: Do not check incomplete as completed, but leave the remaining quantity and expected completion time.
translations.이상 시: 미주문·대체·누락품은 정상 입고와 구분하고 책임자에게 확인해요: In case of abnormalities: Distinguish unordered, substituted, or missing items from normal stock and check with the person in charge.
In case of abnormalities: In case of repeated blockages or water leaks, temporary measures and restrictions on use are taken over.
translations.이상 시: 받기 어려우면 책임자에게 연결해요. 가능하지 않은 자동 콜백을: In case of a problem: If it is difficult to receive, contact the person in charge. We do not promise automatic callbacks unless possible.
In case of abnormality: If discharge is not possible, record the location and person in charge of next disposal.
translations.이상 시: 배출 장소가 잠겨 있으면 임의 장소에 두지 말고 임시 보관을: In case of abnormality: If the discharge location is locked, do not leave it in a random place and check for temporary storage.
translations.이상 시: 배합·기준이 없거나 주문량이 바뀌면 임의로 늘리지 말고 담당자: In case of abnormalities: If there are no formulations/standards or the order quantity changes, do not arbitrarily increase it but adjust it with the person in charge.

In case of abnormality: Do not remove the protective cover or reach into the hazardous area to find the cause.
translations.이상 시: 부재 문의는 확인할 담당과 회신 약속을 남기되 실제로 연결되지: In case of abnormalities: For absence inquiries, leave an appointment with the person in charge to check, but do not say that you have actually sent a notification that was not connected.
